name: bobel vyghan
text: Bobel vyghan is the Cornish designation of the fairies. The Cornish phrase translates as the little people. Cornish speakers used it as their word for the fairy kind. MacKillop marks the term as Cornish and points to the fairy entry.

attributes.attribute: Cornish term for the fairies, glossed as the little people

okr.objective: Record bobel vyghan as the Cornish term for the fairies.
